hook: *10 lakh* vehicles hit Cyberabad roads daily, police chief says
hook_b: *10 lakh* vehicles hit Cyberabad roads daily, police chief says
tldr: At the 3rd HCL Hyderabad Cyclothon, where 2,500+ cyclists rode, Cyberabad CP M Ramesh flagged rising congestion and urged public transport, carpooling and cycling.

beats.what: The third HCL Hyderabad Cyclothon was held at Prime Arena on Sunday, with the Green Race and other categories.
beats.why: Cyberabad police are pushing alternatives to private vehicles as congestion grows.
beats.care: If you commute in the IT corridor, the Nov 26-28 symposium is where mobility plans get discussed.
